notes: «هو خالد بن دينار» after «أبو خلدة» is an editor's gloss and is left out.
«قال يونس بن بكير أخبرنا أبو خلدة» and «وقال بشر بن ثابت حدثنا أبو خلدة» are other transmitters: variant remarks, never routes.

The text then turns to a second saying (Bishr's: the Friday prayer and the question to Anas, «كيف كان النبي ... يصلي الظهر»), with its own isnad and a cut-off end: needs_ruling, since the second saying is not settled by the rules.
